wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.
